result.notes: Verified with a short json check script after writing (count and ids matched), not with a Read of the output file.

Judged all 25 records myself, one at a time, with no programs or keyword rules. Output written to C:/tmp/tiab-wf-bench/out/WH/batch_001.json and read back once. The read-back showed a valid array of 25 objects with ids in input order. Borderline records SLIM-3, SLIM-23 and SLIM-24 were given mid-range probabilities (0.25, 0.45, 0.5). Records without abstracts (SLIM-13, SLIM-16, SLIM-25) were judged from the title alone.

Input had 25 records (Depression-SLIM-26 to -50). Each judged by reading, no classification program. Only Depression-SLIM-28 and -38 are clear in vivo depression models (0.9 and 0.97). -30 (parrot depression as clinical sign), -50 (serotonergic review abstract) are included as uncertain. The output file was checked with a Python id and count comparison (25 = 25, ids match in order), not by a Read-back.
Read-back check was done with a short python one-liner (count and id order only), not Read tool.
